_comment: SYNTHETIC claim-policy rulebook for Employee Q&A. The official kickoff rulebook is not in this repo; swap it in with REIMBURSE_QA_RULEBOOK=<path to a JSON file of the same shape>. Figures mirror data/policy.json (version 2026.2).
title: Kebijakan Perjalanan Dinas / Business Travel Policy (synthetic)

articles.text_id: Kebijakan ini mengatur penggantian biaya perjalanan dinas karyawan PT Nusantara Niaga Digital. Keputusan akhir atas setiap klaim ada di tim finance.
articles.text_en: This policy covers reimbursement of business-travel costs for employees of PT Nusantara Niaga Digital. Finance makes the final decision on every claim.

articles.text_id: Kategori yang bisa diklaim: tiket pesawat (flight), hotel, biaya late check-out, makan (meal), uang harian (per diem), dan taksi. Kategori lain tidak diganti.
articles.text_en: Claimable categories: flight, hotel, late check-out fee, meal, per diem and taxi. Other categories are not reimbursed.

articles.text_id: Tier 1: Jakarta, Surabaya, Denpasar. Tier 2: Makassar, Medan, Yogyakarta, Balikpapan. Kota yang tidak tercantum masuk tier 2.
articles.text_en: Tier 1: Jakarta, Surabaya, Denpasar. Tier 2: Makassar, Medan, Yogyakarta, Balikpapan. Cities not listed are tier 2.

articles.text_id: Plafon hotel per malam: kota tier 1 (Jakarta, Surabaya, Denpasar) Rp1.200.000; kota tier 2 Rp800.000. Kelebihan di atas plafon hanya diganti jika ada memo persetujuan yang sudah ditandatangani.
articles.text_en: Hotel cap per night: tier-1 cities (Jakarta, Surabaya, Denpasar) Rp1.200.000; tier-2 cities Rp800.000. Any excess is reimbursed only with a signed approval memo.

articles.text_id: Uang harian dibayar per hari perjalanan (hari pertama dan terakhir ikut dihitung) sesuai tier kota tujuan: tier 1 Rp450.000 per hari, tier 2 Rp350.000 per hari. Klaim di atas jumlah itu tidak diganti.
articles.text_en: Per diem is paid per trip day (first and last day included) at the destination tier rate: tier 1 Rp450.000 per day, tier 2 Rp350.000 per day. Anything above that is not reimbursed.

articles.text_id: Setiap item tiket pesawat, hotel, late check-out, taksi, dan makan wajib disertai bukti pembayaran (kwitansi/struk). Tiket pesawat juga wajib disertai boarding pass yang cocok dengan nomor penerbangan, tanggal, dan nama penumpang. Uang harian tidak perlu kwitansi.
articles.text_en: Every flight, hotel, late check-out, taxi and meal item needs a receipt. Flights also need a boarding pass matching the flight number, date and passenger name. Per diem needs no receipt.

articles.text_id: Tanggal setiap biaya dan setiap malam hotel harus berada di dalam tanggal perjalanan dinas.
articles.text_en: Every expense date and every hotel night must fall within the trip dates.

articles.text_id: Dua item dengan nomor bukti yang sama dianggap duplikat. Item dengan kategori, tanggal, dan nominal sama tanpa nomor bukti berbeda akan ditinjau finance.
articles.text_en: Two items with the same receipt number are duplicates. Items with the same category, date and amount and no distinct receipt numbers are reviewed by finance.

articles.text_id: Biaya late check-out hanya diganti jika ada rapat dinas di kota hotel yang selesai setelah jam check-out standar 12:00, dan check-out paling lambat 2 jam setelah rapat selesai. Batasnya 50% dari plafon hotel per malam: tier 1 Rp600.000, tier 2 Rp400.000.
articles.text_en: A late check-out fee is reimbursed only when a business meeting in the hotel's city ends after the standard 12:00 check-out and check-out is at most 2 hours after the meeting ends. The limit is 50% of the nightly hotel cap: tier 1 Rp600.000, tier 2 Rp400.000.

articles.text_id: Pemeriksaan otomatis hanya membantu. Keputusan akhir ada di finance. Pertanyaan di luar kebijakan ini: hubungi Tim Finance di reimburse@nusantara-niaga.example.
articles.text_en: Automated checks only assist. Finance makes the final decision. For questions outside this policy, contact the Finance team at reimburse@nusantara-niaga.example.
